description: This file defines classes and functions for interacting with Microsoft Outlook API, including calendar, event, and message management tools, using schemas, HTTP requests, and dynamic tool creation.

classes.name: BaseOutlookTool
classes.description: Base class for Outlook API tools, providing request handling and email parsing.

classes.name: ListCalendarsTool
classes.description: Tool to list Outlook calendars.

classes.name: GetCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to retrieve a specific Outlook calendar.

classes.name: CreateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to create a new Outlook calendar.

classes.name: UpdateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to update an existing Outlook calendar.

classes.name: DeleteCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to delete an Outlook calendar.

classes.name: ListEventsTool
classes.description: Tool to list events in Outlook calendar.

classes.name: GetEventTool
classes.description: Tool to retrieve a specific Outlook event.

classes.name: CreateEventTool
classes.description: Tool to create a new Outlook event.

classes.name: UpdateEventTool
classes.description: Tool to update an Outlook event.

classes.name: DeleteEventTool
classes.description: Tool to delete an Outlook event.

classes.name: ListMessagesTool
classes.description: Tool to list Outlook mailbox messages.

classes.name: GetMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to retrieve a specific message.

classes.name: CreateDraftMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to create a draft message.

classes.name: SendMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to send an Outlook message.

classes.name: UpdateMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to update a message.

classes.name: DeleteMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to delete a message.

classes.name: CopyMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to copy a message to another folder.

classes.name: MoveMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to move a message to another folder.

classes.name: ReplyMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to reply to a message.

classes.name: ForwardMessageTool
classes.description: Tool to forward a message.

methods.name: makeGraphRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to Microsoft Graph API with authorization.

methods.name: parseEmailAddresses
methods.description: Parses comma-separated email addresses into Graph API recipient objects.
